summary: Wheeler Real Estate Investment Trust filed an 8-K disclosing a third amendment to its December 5, 2023 letter agreement with the Stilwell Holders (Stilwell Activist Investments, Stilwell Activist Fund, Stilwell Value Partners VII, Stilwell Associates). The standstill blocking conversion of Wheeler's 7.00% Subordinated Convertible Notes due 2031 if it would give the Stilwell group 50% or more of voting power was extended from December 7, 2026 to December 7, 2028. In exchange, Wheeler granted resale registration rights covering 710,466 Series B Convertible Preferred shares held by Stilwell. Watch conversion overhang and possible Stilwell influence escalation.
